newsitem.title: USA: DecisionOne sees FY97 earnings on track.
newsitem.headline: DecisionOne sees FY97 earnings on track.

text.p: DecisionOne Holdings Corp said Wednesday its objective was still to earn between $1.10 and $1.30 per share for fiscal 1997, excluding charges.
The company was not immediately available to comment further on the forecast.
The company reported second quarter net earnings of $0.17 per share compared to $0.03 per share in the year-ago quarter.
DecisionOne said acquisition opportunities, combined with marketing efforts and steady operating improvements, would continue to fuel growth.
President Stephen Felice also said the company was encouraged by recent new contract bookings and the developing sales pipeline.
DecisionOne provides multivendor computer maintenance and technology support services in North America.
